dtsPropsFor.AmountBox: /** field label, e.g. 'Số tiền' */ label: string; /** thousands of đồng (1700 = 1.700.000 ₫); null = empty */ value: number | null; onChange: (v: number | null) => void; accent?: 'green' | 'amber'; /** shows a ± toggle */ allowNegative?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean;
dtsPropsFor.DateField: /** 'yyyy-MM-dd'; shown as dd/MM/yyyy */ value: string | null; min?: string; max?: string | null; onChange: (v: string) => void; /** red border */ bad?: boolean;
dtsPropsFor.BottomBar: /** icon is an emoji */ tabs: ReadonlyArray<{ key: string; icon: string; label: string }>; current: string; onSelect: (key: string) => void;
dtsPropsFor.Bars: /** one bar per day; amounts in thousands of đồng */ days: Array<{ date: string; amount: number }>;
dtsPropsFor.Ico: /** an emoji */ icon: string; /** null = untracked: dashed '?' tile */ color: ('orange' | 'blue' | 'pink' | 'violet' | 'green' | 'amber' | 'indigo' | 'slate' | 'red' | 'teal' | 'cyan' | 'lime') | null; size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'; /** solid color at ~33% alpha instead of the pale tint */ strong?: boolean;
dtsPropsFor.GoalCard: g: { id: string; name: string; icon: string; color: ('orange' | 'blue' | 'pink' | 'violet' | 'green' | 'amber' | 'indigo' | 'slate' | 'red' | 'teal' | 'cyan' | 'lime'); target: number; done: boolean }; /** thousands of đồng */ spent: number; onClick: () => void;
dtsPropsFor.PeriodDates: /** only start/end are read; end null = active period ('chưa kết thúc') */ p: { start: string; end: string | null };
dtsPropsFor.ExpenseRow: /** the period, for the category name/color lookup: category 'living' -> p.living (named 'Sinh hoạt'), else a goal id in p.goals */ p: { id: string; name: string; start: string; end: string | null; living: { max: number; icon: string; color: ('orange' | 'blue' | 'pink' | 'violet' | 'green' | 'amber' | 'indigo' | 'slate' | 'red' | 'teal' | 'cyan' | 'lime') }; goals: Array<{ id: string; name: string; icon: string; color: ('orange' | 'blue' | 'pink' | 'violet' | 'green' | 'amber' | 'indigo' | 'slate' | 'red' | 'teal' | 'cyan' | 'lime'); target: number; done: boolean }>; expenses: unknown[]; incomes: unknown[]; transfers: unknown[]; createdAt: number }; e: { id: string; amount: number; category: string | null; description: string; date: string; createdAt: number }; /** amounts >= this are red */ large: number; /** plays the 'just added' highlight */ fresh: boolean; onClick: () => void;
dtsPropsFor.IncomeRow: /** amount may be negative */ i: { id: string; amount: number; description: string; date: string; createdAt: number }; fresh: boolean; onClick: () => void;
dtsPropsFor.TransferRow: /** in = deposit to savings, out = withdrawal */ t: { id: string; dir: 'in' | 'out'; amount: number; date: string; createdAt: number }; fresh: boolean; onClick: () => void;
